column1: # clues.tsv for ex24 (the Makefile) — pedagogic hints only. NEVER state the expected value or the fix.
# The build test prints its own reasons; these are the questions behind them.
Where does the subject say the sources and the headers live, and where must the library end up? Your Makefile runs from the exercise directory: every path in it is relative to that.
Which files may your Makefile compile? Only the five the subject names — and the Norm asks for every source to be written out, never matched with a wildcard.
What should a second `make`, right after the first, have left to do? And what exactly does each of clean, fclean and re promise to leave behind?
